answer: A decaying island bond blocks fake identities. Each agent locks 70 credits on one island plot and files each epoch a saffron-sealed receipt of a fresh nectar harvest. No valid receipt costs 7 credits per epoch; a reused receipt burns the rest. Filing costs 40, rising 6 per repeat, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented nectar receipts fail, each key-bound to one plot and epoch. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps the bond.
